title: AI Chatbots for Mental Health: Values and Harms from Lived Experiences of Depression
reasoning: The paper is grounded in Value-Sensitive Design (VSD) and identifies, explores, and evaluates value systems (such as privacy and crisis management) and ethical harms associated with AI chatbots in the context of mental health. It specifically addresses ethical concerns and moral dilemmas in AI design as a core component of its empirical study.
